name: Shutter Ring
summary: A phone camera with a mode wheel, tap to focus and a shutter that morphs for night, portrait, video and pano
about: A camera screen built around one shutter that changes with the mode: a plain disc for photos, a red dot that squares into a stop button while recording, a moon with a hold-still ring at night and a sweep guide for panoramas. The drawn rooftop scene sways like a hand-held phone, portrait mode blurs the background behind the cat, and every picture freezes, shrinks and flies along an arc into the gallery button.
how: Tap anywhere in the picture to focus there; drag the little sun beside the yellow square up or down to change the exposure.
Swipe sideways on the picture, tap a mode name or use the left and right arrow keys to move between Night, Portrait, Photo, Video and Pano.
Press the shutter: photos flash and fly to the gallery, video records until you press again, night holds for three seconds and pano sweeps across.
Zoom with the .6, 1 and 2 chips or the mouse wheel, cycle the flash at top left and flip to the front camera at bottom right.
Tap the gallery button to look through every shot, and Back to camera (or Escape) to return. Space takes a picture.
